# FLAGS AND COATS OF ARMS, written in the language of flags.js (described in flags.html, which shows them all).
# `CODE Name: definition`, one per line; a line that starts with a space continues the one before; # and a space start a comment.
# Codes are the map's own: ISO 3166-1 for countries and dependencies (FR), ISO 3166-2 for states (DE-BY); CODE-arms is a
# country's coat of arms; lower-case codes are parts that others use (@castile). The flags are their simplest versions:
# no lettering, and an emblem only as a plain shape where it is needed to tell the flag apart. Colours are by name (flags.js
# COLORS: each the usual shade on flags, near enough), not by code.

# ---- parts, used by the arms and flags below ------------------------------------------------------------------------
